changelog: Phase 32B.1 — fix billing-trial-reminder.php script crashes on prod. (1) Removed brand_name from SELECT — Phase 14 control-plane schema only has brand_slug, not brand_name (display name lives in tenant-side settings JSON, not control-plane). Display now uses brand_slug as the recognisable identifier. (2) Set sane $_SERVER defaults (REQUEST_URI, HTTP_HOST, REMOTE_ADDR, REQUEST_METHOD) before requiring session_init.php to suppress PHP 8 warnings when invoked from CLI cron context. The script's logic and email templates unchanged — only the SQL column reference and CLI bootstrap were broken.
